verdicts.identification: Cedar Terra obfuscated Go native loader
verdicts.reason: Concealed native payload execution and PEB image identity substitution, without an identified legitimate product or authorized deployment context.
evidence: Go 1.23.1 buildinfo identifies CedarTerraHoldings; main-package identifiers are randomized and the decoder is buried among repeated sorting/printing junk.
Authenticode digests match and signer cryptography verifies. Cedar Terra Holdings is a self-issued/self-signed leaf; a valid DigiCert timestamp is not publisher trust.

Actual decoder main.eLwQAWRkPY at 0x559320 reconstructs 1453461 bytes through index-dependent subtraction, buffer reversal and adjacent byte swaps. Recovered PE64 SHA256 5c5387b0191cebef4a2f832312013695b569a8d29cdeeb78dfc82b51857fd6e2 has preferred base 0x660000000 and entry RVA 0x2225c; it has no import directory.

main.main reserves executable memory through VirtualAlloc, maps the native image and registers its exception table through RtlAddFunctionTable. NtQueryInformationThread supplies a TEB; the loader follows TEB+0x60 to PEB and writes the mapped image base at PEB+0x10.

Isolated Unicorn execution of the original Go instructions with explicit runtime/OS stubs logged the PEB ImageBaseAddress write at 0x4eed19 (value 0x20165b90) and syscall.SyscallN handoff to 0x20187dec = mapped base + entry RVA. Stubs model OS services; this is not a claim of successful execution on Windows.
The obfuscated native stage contains further opaque code and environment gating. The external Vidar attribution is not independently confirmed, and credential theft is not claimed.
verdicts.external_provenance: Malware-corpus provenance corroborates the independently observed loader behavior; family labels and engine counts are not behavioral proof.
verdicts.missing_context: No installation origin, operator authorization or victim deployment context was supplied. Final payload family and successful runtime effects are not established.
verdicts.marker_line: Cedar Terra loader: hidden PE/PEB rewrite; cover register variants

verdicts.reason: Patched sideload export suppresses the legitimate host and executes an RC4-encrypted certificate-table downloader; this packaging establishes abuse of the legitimate Microsoft component.
evidence: ISO9660/Joliet DISC contains a 508456-byte Microsoft BioEnrollmentHost executable and a 440832-byte wincorlib.dll. Its 4096-byte unclaimed tail has only four nonzero bytes and no additional executable payload.

The host version identifies BioEnrollmentHost.exe 10.0.19041.4355 and the PE imports wincorlib!Platform::Details::Heap::Allocate. Its Microsoft Authenticode content digest still matches, but its certificate table contains 30280 unsigned trailing bytes. Local osslsigncode trust validation cannot build the issuer chain; digest integrity is distinguished from chain trust.

The companion DLL retains Microsoft WinRT core-library version claims but lacks a signature and has a new RWX section. The Allocate export is redirected to RVA 0x6f892, inside that section. No filename is required by the new attack matchers.

The redirected export resolves APIs manually, obtains the host entry using PEB.ImageBaseAddress and NT.AddressOfEntryPoint, changes page protection, and writes a Sleep(INFINITE) trampoline at 0x18006fa3a..0x18006fa5c. A new thread runs the loader; the host entry and allocation call are suppressed.

Code at 0x18006f2b0 opens the host image, validates its PE64 header, reads the security-directory file offset and size, seeks to that table and reads its data. It locates an eight-byte framing marker, copies the following bytes, applies RC4 with the stack-built key AtkExEmbedKey2026, changes the buffer to RX and invokes it.

The recovered 30272-byte native stage resolves CreateThread/VirtualProtect, overwrites the host entry with a loop and starts a worker at stage+0x6da0. Worker 0x6b60 XOR-decodes the URL using 0x5a, requests it through WinHTTP at 0x5fa0, stores downloaded bytes as REG_BINARY under HKCU Software\PngCache value 1.png at 0x6dc0, makes the response executable and invokes it at 0x6d7c.

The worker calls an elevation helper at stage+0x1a0. Its reachable helper constructs Elevation:Administrator!new:{3E5FC7F9-9A51-4367-9063-A120244FBEC7}, calls CoGetObject at 0xe62 and invokes the returned interface at 0xf29. Supporting code rewrites process-parameter identity using SystemPropertiesAdvanced.exe and coordinates an elevation relaunch with named events/--evhs=. This establishes an attempted elevation path, not runtime success.

Forager retrieved https://aawwf.hkg.bcebos.com/shiade/A03.bin with provenance preserved in scratch. The 104627-byte response is position-independent x64 native loader code: its initial relative CALL skips a 0x1641e-byte data block, POP RCX recovers the data pointer at 0x16423, and the next function uses a pointer table and hashed API resolution. Its final embedded program/operator identity was not established.

extensions: Retain every existing Go arithmetic/pair-swap/entry-sum matcher alternative and add the observed BX/SI/DI and DX/SI forms. Accept the observed zero forwarding from R8 to R11 in the Go ABI allocation setup. Existing layered-transform, manual-mapper and PEB-substitution objectives now fire.
additions: RC4 stack-state byte PRGA; ROR13 name/ordinal/function export traversal; PE64 security-table/RX-buffer call chain; certificate-table code concealment; host-entry infinite-sleep patch and Microsoft-DLL disguise context; unsigned bytes following Authenticode SignedData.
precision: No campaign URL, key, marker, payload length, section label, collector name or sample hash gates the new hostile rules. The sleep objective requires the infinite-sleep trampoline; its hostile composite also requires an unsigned Microsoft-claim DLL.
The certificate concealment objective requires both the security-table-to-RX-buffer invocation shape and nearby RC4 PRGA, rather than generic crypto or signing metadata.

verification.focused_checks: All exited 0. Existing instruction variants and benign near misses retained; new controls remove RC4 XOR, security-directory reads, infinite-sleep immediate or Microsoft claim; rename controls preserve matching. Removing the unsigned carrier suffix removes only that new carrier fact.
verification.final_validation: make validate is the required final action after this evidence record and judgement markers are written.

remaining_gaps: The configured classifier leaves all three originals unflagged (lvl -1, conf 0, model cls 0) despite the post-change probabilities and two hostile findings per malicious file/container. This disagreement is retained, not corrected by duplicate or inaccurate rules.
The signed carrier alone gains an unsigned-certificate-suffix observation, not a hostile rule: the loader relationship is established by its companion. The archive inherits the DLL hostile findings.

The static scanner does not decrypt the RC4 certificate stage or the arithmetic Go layer automatically. Recovered-stage WinHTTP/registry/elevation behavior and native payload identities therefore remain beyond original-layer trait coverage. No credential theft, persistence trigger, live elevation success or final family attribution is invented.
